<?php
namespace App\Livewire;

use Illuminate\View\View;
use Livewire\Attributes\Locked;
use Livewire\Component;
use Symfony\Component\HttpFoundation\StreamedResponse;

class ConfigDrivenRegister extends Component
{
    private const FIELDS = [
        ['key' => 'name', 'label' => 'Endpoint', 'required' => true],
        ['key' => 'branch', 'label' => 'Branch', 'required' => false],
        ['key' => 'type', 'label' => 'Type', 'required' => false],
    ];

    #[Locked]
    public array $rows = [
        ['id' => 1, 'name' => 'NH-WS-014', 'branch' => 'North Hub', 'type' => 'Workstation'],
        ['id' => 2, 'name' => 'HO-LT-007', 'branch' => 'Harbor Office', 'type' => 'Laptop'],
    ];
    #[Locked]
    public array $history = [];
    #[Locked]
    public ?int $editingId = null;
    public bool $editing = false;
    public ?int $historyId = null;
    public array $form = [];
    public string $search = '';
    public string $notice = '';

    public function edit(?int $id = null): void
    {
        $row = $id === null ? [] : collect($this->rows)->firstWhere('id', $id);
        abort_if($row === null, 404);
        $this->resetValidation();
        $this->editingId = $id;
        foreach (self::FIELDS as $field) {
            $this->form[$field['key']] = $row[$field['key']] ?? '';
        }
        $this->editing = true;
    }

    private function cleanForWrite(array $form): array
    {
        $clean = [];
        foreach (self::FIELDS as $field) {
            $value = trim((string) ($form[$field['key']] ?? ''));
            $clean[$field['key']] = $value === '' ? null : $value;
        }
        return $clean;
    }

    public function save(): void
    {
        abort_unless($this->editing, 422);
        $rules = [];
        foreach (self::FIELDS as $field) {
            $rules['form.'.$field['key']] = [$field['required'] ? 'required' : 'nullable', 'string', 'max:120'];
        }
        $clean = $this->cleanForWrite($this->validate($rules)['form']);
        $id = $this->editingId ?? (max([0, ...array_column($this->rows, 'id')]) + 1);
        $index = array_search($id, array_column($this->rows, 'id'), true);
        $previous = $index === false ? [] : $this->rows[$index];
        $diffs = [];
        foreach (self::FIELDS as $field) {
            $before = $previous[$field['key']] ?? null;
            $after = $clean[$field['key']];
            if ($before !== $after) {
                $diffs[] = ['label' => $field['label'], 'before' => $before, 'after' => $after];
            }
        }
        $this->rows[$index === false ? count($this->rows) : $index] = ['id' => $id, ...$clean];
        if ($diffs) {
            $this->history[] = ['id' => $id, 'version' => collect($this->history)->where('id', $id)->count() + 1, 'diffs' => $diffs];
        }
        $this->notice = $diffs ? 'Saved '.$clean['name'].'.' : 'No fields changed.';
        $this->editing = false;
    }

    private function visible(): array
    {
        $term = mb_strtolower(trim($this->search));
        return array_filter($this->rows, static function (array $row) use ($term): bool {
            foreach (self::FIELDS as $field) {
                if (str_contains(mb_strtolower((string) $row[$field['key']]), $term)) {
                    return true;
                }
            }
            return false;
        });
    }

    public function exportCsv(): StreamedResponse
    {
        $visible = $this->visible();
        return response()->streamDownload(static function () use ($visible) {
            $out = fopen('php://output', 'wb');
            fwrite($out, "\xEF\xBB\xBF");
            fputcsv($out, array_column(self::FIELDS, 'label'), ',', '"', '', "\r\n");
            foreach ($visible as $row) {
                $cells = [];
                foreach (self::FIELDS as $field) {
                    $text = (string) $row[$field['key']];
                    $cells[] = preg_match('/^\s*[=+@-]/u', $text) ? "'".$text : $text;
                }
                fputcsv($out, $cells, ',', '"', '', "\r\n");
            }
            fclose($out);
        }, 'endpoint-register.csv', ['Content-Type' => 'text/csv; charset=utf-8']);
    }

    public function render(): View
    {
        return view('livewire.config-driven-register', [
            'fields' => self::FIELDS,
            'visible' => $this->visible(),
            'changes' => array_reverse(array_filter($this->history, fn ($change) => $change['id'] === $this->historyId)),
        ]);
    }
}
